reason: I cut most of the hair myself with one or two chairs, so I already know who sat where and how much came in, and my register has never lied to me. Paying ₹4,999 plus ₹999 every month for an app to watch a shop I'm standing in doesn't add up.
objection: I lost two good stylists last year. If I make the ones I have take a selfie to clock in and track their cancelled bills, they will feel I don't trust them and walk to the salon next door.
would_change_my_mind: If it was only the WhatsApp reminder and wallet for customers, with no staff selfie or tracking, for a couple of hundred rupees a month and no setup fee, I might try it after the free month.
